info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balances Retrieval API provides access to customer loyalty balances, allowing businesses to monitor and manage customer rewards. This endpoint returns the current loyalty balances for individual customers, facilitating the tracking of rewards and points accrued through customer interactions. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program developers and customer relationship management systems. This resource is essential for organizations aiming to enhance customer engagement and retention through effective loyalty program management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current loyalty balance, providing insights into their rewards status and total points accumulated.
